quotes.author: AprilandJoey Odekerken
quotes.text: Cooper was amazing! He made the trip fun and full of knowledge for all of us. Nothing phased him and he had such a positive attitude the whole day. It was honestly so enjoyable that our group would’ve wanted to do it again that evening but our fish limit was met and we were leaving next day. We had a group of five people: 2 adults and a child fishing and 2 adults just enjoying the day not fishing, and everyone felt like it was the perfect day! My 4 year old son caught his first fish! And second, third and fourth fish as well! Thank you Cooper!

quotes.author: Justin Courtad
quotes.text: Oh man we had so much fun! Went on the 4:30 charter with Captain Cooper and that guy really knows his stuff. We came home with about 10 keepers and in all we had about 25-30 fish on our lines. The setting in the mountains couldn’t be any prettier. Captain was very professional and was great with our two 13 year olds and answered all 12 million of their questions. When we hit the dock he wasted no time and got us right out. He gutted and butterflied our fish as well! Couldn’t recommend Big Ed’s more. You won’t regret it!

quotes.author: Gary Alford
quotes.text: Brought my grand daughter only 9 fishing. Amy, our guide, was fantastic. She was very attentive teaching my grand daughter how to cast and catch; and patient with my snags and hang ups LOL. We both enjoyed learning as she shared her knowledge of the lake, environment, and fish. She made sure it was an awesome day catching fish and memories with my grand daughter. Looking forward to coming back- my grand daughter as well. Can’t wait!

quotes.author: Katherine Wolman
quotes.text: We went fishing today with 5 kids and 4 adults and had the BEST experience. Cooper was an amazing guide who did the best job ensuring a fun time for everyone. Would highly recommend Big Ed’s for anyone looking to go fishing on the lake.

quotes.author: Tanner Tomlinson
quotes.text: It was an amazing experience. Dylan was one heck of a guide. We caught fish and had a great time for my brother bachelor party, and Dylan made sure everyone felt welcome and was helpful with any questions we had. Highly recommend!!

quotes.author: Rebecca
quotes.text: Me and my husband Frank Had a wonderful trip fishing with Big ed’s. Breckenridge fishing was the highlight of our trip. The knowledgeable guides put my 85 year old husband on numerous Rainbow Trout. Beautiful July morning! Thanks!
